## The Pitch (1-page summary)

### Sandra,

Six years ago, you signed with us when we had 6 properties. Today we manage 24, and you're one of the 4 owners who's been with us from the start. Both your properties have outperformed the market every single year of our partnership. Year 7 is up for renewal July 1, and we'd like the next chapter to be a bigger one.

Here's the case, the math, and the proposal.

## 2. Three Specific Things We Did to Earn the Fee This Year

### 2.1. PC-02 listing rewrite + photo refresh (Aug 2025)

We rebuilt your PC-02 listing copy for the 2025–26 ski season and re-shot the property in November. Result:
- Airbnb listing rank improved from #28 to #14 (within Canyons Village 3BR class)
- Direct-booking share for PC-02 grew from 56% to 71% — that's $9,400 in additional margin (the take-rate avoidance vs. Airbnb)
- The Aug 2025 hero photo (your patio at twilight with the Canyons in the background) was the most-clicked image we had on social all of Q4

### 2.2. Hostaway → PriceLabs integration (Feb 2026)

Both your units were among the first 8 we migrated to PriceLabs dynamic pricing. Your ADR is up 9% YoY (vs. portfolio average of 5%), with no occupancy degradation — actually +6 points. We project this delta is worth ~$14K/year in incremental revenue at a 20% management fee, that's $11,200 net to you.

### 2.3. Repeat-guest direct-booking funnel (rolling)

Eleven of your bookings in the last 12 months were repeat guests booking direct (vs. through Airbnb), saving them ~$200/booking and saving you ~$285/booking in retained margin. That's $3,135 of margin flowing to your statement that wouldn't have if those guests had re-booked on Airbnb. We do this through Mia's post-stay outreach + the /properties/aspen-loft direct-booking page.

## 3. Looking at the Comp Set

The biggest change this year has been who you're competing against. Six years ago, Canyons Village 2BR/3BR units were 80% professionally managed; today it's 92%. Your 2 units are competing against very polished operators (Vacasa, Evolve, several local indie shops).

| Player | Price point vs. yours | Strengths | Where you beat them |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vacasa (4 units in your class) | -$60 ADR (lower) | Scale, Booking.com listing, brand | Reviews (4.71 vs. 4.91), local responsiveness |
| Evolve (3 units) | -$110 ADR | Lower fee structure (15%) | Direct-booking share (yours 71% vs. theirs ~22%), local knowledge |
| Indie host A (1 unit, similar floor plan to PC-02) | +$20 ADR | Premier Host on Airbnb | Volume + repeat-booking funnel |
| **You + Pinecrest** | **base** | **All of the above (locally), better cleanliness, AI Ambassador** | |

Your premium pricing holds because the reviews + repeat bookings + direct-channel mix make our properties stand out. If we drop our touch (say, by trying to manage 60 properties with the same team), we'd lose this. So we've intentionally been selective about new owners.

## 4. The Renewal Proposal

### Same fee structure (20%) for the next 12 months

Your 20% rate stays. Below market for a multi-property operator at our service level (industry avg is 25–35%), but I'm not raising it.

### Add-on: Booking.com onboarding (optional, recommended)

We're onboarding Pinecrest to Booking.com starting Sep 1. Your two units would be in the first 8. Estimated incremental revenue: $7,500–$11,000 on PC-01 + PC-02 combined for the 2026–27 ski season, primarily international guests who are Booking.com first.

- Pinecrest absorbs the 8% Booking.com take rate within our existing 20% (no fee-stack on you)
- You get the upside revenue
- Setup time: 2 weeks. Risk: minimal — Hostaway already handles the channel sync

We'd like your sign-off to opt PC-01 + PC-02 into the Sep 1 launch.

### Multi-year option (incentive to lock in)

If you'd like to commit through Jul 2028 (24 months), we'll drop your fee to **19%** retroactive to renewal. This is the same offer we make to all multi-property owners on contract anniversaries — it's worth $2,400/year to you on current revenue.
